title: Representative signed shift equation for reindexing
statement:
theorem derived_shift_model {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ)
    (SX : Closed l E X s) (SY : Closed l E Y s)
    (TX : Models l E X s SX) (TY : Models l E Y s SY)
    (c : Comparison l E g s SX SY TX TY) :
    ∀ (P I : K l E Y s) (hI : I.IsKInjective) (a b : ℤ),
      derivedShiftEquation l E g s SX SY TX TY c
        ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)
        ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I) a b

source.place: Step 4; representative localization model sub-obligation extracted from lem-pod-reindexing-shift-derived-part.

proof.text: Use the chosen K-injective representative in `Comparison.derived_model`, transport the signed source and target shifts through the chain shift comparison, and compare every Hom-product projection. The projection formula identifies both composites degree by degree.

proof_origin.place: Strict decomposition of the derived signed-shift field into representative and localization obligations.
